items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Pig domestication represents a pivotal development in Holocene human societies, and domesticated pig exploitation, in particular, has attracted widespread discussions. The lower Yangtze River region is recognized as one of the significant centers for the earliest domestication and use of domesticated pigs in China. However, the regional trajectory of domesticated pig exploitation during the late Neolithic period in this region remains unclear. In this case study, we utilized stable isotope evidence from pig bones recovered at the Jiangjiashan and Weidun sites during the late Majiabang culture in the Taihu Lake region and the Tianluoshan site of Hemudu culture in the Ningshao Plain. Our study reveals that pig δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N values at each of the three sites exhibit a wide range of variation, indicating differences in their food sources. When combined with the zooarchaeological evidence, this phenomenon is suggested to be associated with the emergence of domestic pig management. Through systematic analysis of pig diets in the late Neolithic lower Yangtze River region, contrasting diachronic shifts in pig diets are exhibited between Tiahu Lake region and Ningshao Plain. In the Taihu Lake region, a diachronic shift from a wild boar foraging ecology to intensified human feeding management is evidenced by a significant increase in mean δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N values and an initial expansion followed by a contraction in δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N value variability from the early Majiabang to the Songze period, indicating the emergence and progressive management of domestic pigs through increased provisioning of human food waste. In contrast, pigs on the Ningshao Plain during the Hemudu culture (Phases I–III) exhibited no significant diachronic changes in dietary structure, as evidenced by stable mean δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N values along with a progressively narrowing δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N range, indicating that human management of pig feeding was not intensified over time. Combining zooarchaeological and isotopic evidence, a geographic mosaic pattern of domesticated pig exploitation among different regions is revealed for the late Neolithic period of the lower Yangtze region. A diachronic intensification of domesticated pig exploitation is observed in the Taihu Lake area during the Majiabang and Songze culture periods (7000–5300
                    <jats:sc>bp</jats:sc>
                    ), whereas such a trend is absent in the Ningshao Plain within the Hemudu culture Phases I–III (7000–5700
                    <jats:sc>bp</jats:sc>
                    ). We propose that these divergent pathways resulted from the interplay of local environmental conditions, agricultural development, and demographic pressure.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《稳定同位素视角下新石器时代晚期长江下游家猪利用的地理镶嵌格局》：研究通过蒋家山、圩墩和天螺山遗址猪骨稳定同位素，揭示太湖地区与宁绍平原在家猪饲养管理上的差异化演变路径，值得关注早期人猪关系区域多样性的读者阅读。
items.title: Geographic Mosaics of Domesticated Pig Exploitation in the Late Neolithic Lower Yangtze River From a Stable Isotope Perspective

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Elk (
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>Alces alces</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    ) was the largest wild ungulate available to the forest‐zone towns of medieval Rus', yet it rarely forms more than a trace component of urban faunal assemblages. Here I synthesize published zooarchaeological evidence from key towns (Novgorod and Tver) and comparative datasets from other Rus' urban sites to reassess elk's economic role. In medieval Novgorod, elk remains typically constitute ~0.2% of identified mammal bones, but they are frequently modified: one‐third of elk specimens bear butchery marks, and cranial elements show deliberate splitting and antler pedicle removal. Hinterland sites display complementary patterns, including strong biases toward foot bones and skinning marks, consistent with the import of hides rather than whole carcasses. Together, these signatures indicate that elk entered towns mainly through targeted product flows—antler for craft production and hides for processing—while contributing only marginally to routine urban meat supply. I argue that elk is best understood as an ‘invisible commodity’ of medieval urban economies: materially significant in craft and exchange networks but weakly represented in food waste deposits.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《中世纪罗斯城镇中的驼鹿：肉、皮与鹿角经济》：通过分析诺夫哥罗德、特维尔等城镇的动物考古证据，重新评估驼鹿在城市经济中的角色，指出其遗骸虽仅占已鉴定哺乳动物骨骼约0.2%，却常带屠宰痕迹，且鹿角与兽皮以定向产品流动方式进入城镇，而肉食供应作用有限，适合关注中世纪城市经济与动物考古的读者。
items.title: Elk in Medieval Towns of Rus': Meat, Hides, and Antler Economies

items.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    To assess how the eastern part of the Limfjord system has changed over the Holocene, relative to the wider Limfjord and western Baltic region, a sedimentary succession spanning
                    <jats:italic>c</jats:italic>
                    . 9600–150 cal. a BP was collected from Nibe Bredning, near Sebbersund, from a shallow coastal inlet along the eastern connection between the Limfjord and the Kattegat (north Jutland, Denmark). Palaeoenvironmental conditions were reconstructed using biogeochemical, sedimentological and biological analyses within a chronological framework provided by accelerator mass spectrometry (AMS)
                    <jats:sup>14</jats:sup>
                    C dating of terrestrial plant macrofossils. The Sebbersund succession exhibits brackish conditions prior to 9000 cal. a BP, with substantial input of nutrients and terrestrially sourced organic matter from the catchment. The timing of the marine transgression at Sebbersund beginning around ~9400–9300 cal. a BP agrees well with the general Limfjord development, and key changes in salinity largely correspond with regional sea‐level changes. After ~9300 cal. a BP, salinity increased, reaching levels higher than present day during the Mid‐Holocene (according to diatom‐inferred salinities between 7400 and 4300 cal. a BP), which together with strong marine‐sourced organic matter signatures suggest marine conditions within the fjord, implying a greater connection to adjacent marine systems than at present. Salinities likely remained high until at least 3000 cal. a BP and perhaps later, before declining to modern‐day levels. Sedimentary conditions within the fjord changed after ~3000 cal. a BP as sedimentation rate declined and grain size increased, likely related to shallower conditions following long‐term infilling and falling sea levels. Radiocarbon dating of bulk sediment samples showed the presence of old carbon in the system, creating an age offset between 1640±500 and 2650±170 calibrated
                    <jats:sup>14</jats:sup>
                    C years compared with the age‐depth curve based on the terrestrial macrofossils. This study provides new and important data on Holocene environmental change in the eastern Limfjord, which is crucial for improving our understanding of long‐term marine ecological and geochemical responses to sea‐level and climate change.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《丹麦东利姆峡湾全新世古环境的生物地球化学、沉积学及基于甲藻的重建》：研究利用生物地球化学、沉积学和生物分析，结合AMS碳十四测年，重建了约9600至150 cal. a BP间东利姆峡湾的古环境演变，揭示咸度变化与区域海平面变化的对应关系，并发现沉积物中存在老碳导致的测年偏差，为理解该区域长期海洋生态与地球化学对海平面和气候变化的响应提供了新数据。
items.title: Biogeochemical, sedimentological and dinoflagellate‐based reconstruction of the Holocene palaeoenvironment of the east Limfjord, Denmark

items.abstract: There is broad consensus among paleoanthropologists that extant African hominids (Pan and Gorilla) as well as hominins (our direct ancestors following the split from Pan, i.e., chimpanzee and bonobo) originated in Africa. The prevailing view, that hominins became upright bipeds after moving from tropical forests (the current habitat of Pan and Gorilla) to open savannas in East Africa—where they chased large mammals—is contradicted, however, by fossil, paleo-ecological, and comparative biological and physiological evidence. Here, we propose that hominoids (apes), hominids (great apes), and hominins (humans and fossil species more closely related to Homo than to Pan) instead evolved near water and mostly out of Africa. We propose that Miocene (23.03–5.33 Ma) apes had already evolved an upright, tailless body as an adaptation to living in flooded forests, where they engaged in frequent bipedal wading and below-branch vertical climbing—a type of movement we term vertical aquarborealism. This largely Miocene aquarboreal style of locomotion can be seen as evolutionarily intermediate between the above-branch arboreality of Old World monkeys (Cercopithecoidea) and the various below-branch locomotive styles of extant apes (Hominoidea). Starting from vertical aquarborealism, Homo—at least by the Early Pleistocene (2.58 Ma)—had developed a lifestyle centred around shallow diving, primarily foraging for non-fleeing foods such as shellfish and aquatic plants. We also suggest that the timing of some major tectonic shifts in the African, Arabian, and Eurasian plates during the Miocene, Pliocene, and Pleistocene may help explain key aspects of this evolutionary scenario, including the splitting times of hominoids (apes), hominids, and hominins.
items.summary: 《基于比较生物学与板块构造的猿类与人类演化假说》：该文提出猿类、大猿与人类近亲可能并非在非洲开阔草原演化，而是适应近水环境，中新世猿类已具备直立无尾身体，用于涉水与树下垂直攀爬，人属至早更新世转向浅水潜水觅食，并结合板块构造解释分化时间，值得关注。
items.title: A hypothesis of ape and human evolution based on comparative biology and plate tectonics

items.abstract: This is a case study testing if a Middle Stone Age engraved stone found by Christopher Henshilwood (1999-2000) in Blombos cave, South Africa, has a functional use as a fishing net weaving template. The results have implications indicating advanced cognitive abilities and spatial planning as early as 100,000-75,000 years ago.
items.summary: 《考古学中的数字方法：检验中石器时代布隆伯斯赭石雕刻石器的功能性用途》：该案例研究通过数字方法检验南非布隆伯斯洞穴出土的约十万至七万五千年前雕刻石器是否可用作渔网编织模板，其结论对理解早期人类高级认知能力与空间规划具有启示意义，适合关注中石器时代考古与认知演化的读者阅读。
items.title: Digital Methods in Archaeology: Testing for a Functional Use for the Middle Stone Age (MSA) Engraved Blombos Ochre Stone
